producer_report.summary: I added one paragraph to the change producer brief (producer.md) and a test that checks it is there. The paragraph says each behavior change needs at least one test through the real call site that would fail if the production call were deleted. It names the existing fake agent driver and the nested-run harness. It also tells the producer to name that test in its report. The test `producer_brief_requires_a_real_call_site_test_and_names_it` in `athena-cap-change` reads the embedded prompt text and asserts four key phrases, so removing the paragraph fails it. I also added a CHANGELOG entry and a decision D166 appended to docs/decisions.md. I ran the targeted tests listed under checks, and they pass; fmt, clippy and the full suite are left to Athena's checks.

checks_run.note: 3 passed including the new policy test

criteria_check.evidence: producer.md line 4 reads: 'Each behavior change needs at least one test through the real call site (the existing fake agent driver or nested-run harness where needed) that would fail if the production call were deleted'.

criteria_check.criterion: Grep of crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/producer.md finds an instruction that the producer must name which test that is in its report.

criteria_check.evidence: Test producer_brief_requires_a_real_call_site_test_and_names_it takes Change.producer_section().text (the include_str! asset) and asserts four phrases. It passed in cargo test -p athena-cap-change.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-cap-change`: the new policy test passes, and its assertions would fail if the convention paragraph were removed from producer.md (checkable by reading the diff's assertions against the paragraph).
criteria_check.evidence: Ran cargo test -p athena-cap-change: 3 passed. Each of the four asserted phrases appears only in the new paragraph, so removing it fails the test.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`: the whole suite passes, including any existing token-budget or prompt tests, so the producer (change) prompt stays within its 1300-token budget.

`git diff --stat` shows changes only to crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/producer.md and crates/athena-cap-change/src/lib.rs (plus CHANGELOG.md if the repository convention requires it); no unrelated behavior changes.

open_issues: The convention is prose in the brief with a presence test. Nothing checks that a producer follows it; that was out of scope.
